nodes.label: Astro + Islands Pattern
nodes.rationale: All apps use Astro for static/SSR markup and React only for heavy interactive islands; Alpine.js for minimal interactivity. Separates concerns between static rendering and client-side interactivity.

nodes.label: No Direct Supabase Writes in Frontend
nodes.rationale: Architecture rule enforced by CI: reads go through supabase-client.ts, all writes (insert/update/delete) must call an Edge Function. Prevents bypassing RLS and business logic in Edge Functions.

nodes.label: Cascading State Protocol
nodes.rationale: Strict 4-phase development protocol: Phase 1 Audit->Phase 2 Strategy->Phase 3 Registration->Phase 4 Execution. Each phase requires explicit user ACK before proceeding. Prevents premature coding.
